content:
Talia Reed: Heads-up 12 Apotheon Pharma (APX-88) reporting recurring payment fail for INV-5487 ($11,750). Their AP team says the virtual card provider declined due to MCC restriction (healthcare subscription category). They want to pay via Payoneer or EUR wire.
Noah Brooks: Interesting. MCC blocks happen with some virtual card programs. Do we have decline payload from Stripe/Adyen? If it's an MCC block we can't retry the same card.
PaymentsBot: ALERT: Charge attempt failed for INV-5487. Error: payment_declined (reason: mcc_block). Gateway: adyen. Suggested actions: accept alternate card, accept bank transfer (USD wire), or accept Payoneer payout after verification. Ticket PAY-8604 created.
Talia Reed: Gateway raw event: ```json
{"event":"payment.failed","code":"mcc_block","merchant_category":"5734","invoice":"INV-5487","acct":"APX-88"}
```
Noah Brooks: If they want Payoneer, legal/ops need to confirm vendor acceptance and KYC. Payoneer payouts can take 1-3 business days; not same-day. EUR wire introduces FX risk. Invoice is USD. We need customer to either: (A) wire USD gross to our account, (B) wire EUR with gross-up clause so we get full USD amount, or (C) provide alternate card/payment method.
Kelsey Park: For option B we require a signed gross-up instruction from the customer confirming they will cover conversion and bank fees so Redwood receives $11,750 USD net. Also CFO approval needed for any cross-currency manual settlement >$10k. @Marco Ortiz please advise.
Marco Ortiz: I can approve cross-currency settlement for this one-off if customer signs gross-up + waiver and accepts $45 processing fee. Need written confirmation and Payoneer details if they go that route.
Suki Tan: Can we offer a short hold-for-48hrs unlock (provisional access) while this clears? Customer says they need dev environment live. Financial exposure is $11.7k.
Noah Brooks: We sometimes allow 48-hr provisional access with promissory note + card token capture within window. For cross-currency wires we prefer MT103 trace before granting access. If they pick Payoneer and it's delayed, offer staged access only.
Talia Reed: Messaging customer now with three choices and draft language. Draft wire payload (USD) to send if they pick wire: ```
Please wire USD 11,750.00 to:
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Account: 987654321
Routing: 111000025
Bank: FirstFederal Bank
SWIFT: FFEDUS33
Ref: INV-5487 / APX-88
Include gross-up clause if sending in EUR: "Customer will remit additional funds to cover any FX conversion shortfall so that Redwood receives USD 11,750 net."
```
PaymentsBot: NOTE: If customer chooses Payoneer, create ticket PAY-8604-PAYONEER and collect provider payout proof. For wires, create PAY-8604-WIRE. Audit tags applied.
Kelsey Park: I'll draft the gross-up waiver and promissory template. Talia, please require customer to reply with an explicit acceptance sentence like: "We agree to remit USD 11,750 net to Redwood and cover any bank or FX fees."
Marco Ortiz: Approved pending signed gross-up waiver and customer email acceptance. Finance will clear invoice after bank trace or Payoneer payout confirmation. No provisional access until MT103 or payout receipt unless a promissory + card token is captured.
Talia Reed: Sent options. Customer replied: "We can wire in EUR now but need you to confirm gross-up language; we'll email signed waiver and initiate transfer." They also asked if Redwood can accept partial payment and unlock dev features.
Noah Brooks: Offer staged access conditional on signed promissory. If they only want partial payment, we need a signed payment plan documenting amounts and schedule.
Kelsey Park: Uploaded waiver template to PAY-8604. Once customer signs and sends MT103 we can reconcile. I'll also flag treasury to expect an incoming EUR wire so they can prepare conversion.
PaymentsBot: UPDATE: Ticket PAY-8604 updated. Reminder set: 48-hr follow-up for MT103 or Payoneer confirmation. Audit: CFO approval pending waiver.
Talia Reed: Customer emailed signed waiver and included sender ref 9XJ-332. Forwarding to treasury. Marking thread active until MT103 lands. Thanks all.
